title: Upgrade to v1.28.0 (Cosmos SDK v0.54 / CometBFT v0.39 - eliminate node-local app-hash divergence)
summary: Coordinated release-family migration to Cosmos SDK v0.54 and CometBFT v0.39. The motivation is the upstream fix for the node-local Commit/Query state race (cosmos-sdk #24655): store/v2 rootmulti now keeps lastCommitInfo in an atomic pointer and serializes Commit against query-context creation, which is the canonical fix for the recurring single-node app-hash divergences observed on mirage.talk. The vendored IAVL fork is rebased to v1.2.8 (nodeDB read/write lock plus deferred fast-node cache application) and the fast-node index remains off the consensus read path. The dormant x/group and x/circuit modules are removed (x/group is now Cosmos Enterprise-licensed and x/circuit's wiring proto was dropped in v0.54); their unused KV stores are deleted at the upgrade height via StoreUpgrades. No application state migration is required: store/v2 reuses the same on-disk IAVL v1.2.x format. This is consensus-breaking and must activate at one coordinated height across all validators with every node running the v1.28.0 binary.
